english: The dwarf mutters his greeting with the impact of a growing flower.
He's afraid of you. Dominate him.
You get the vibe here. You know. The vibe.
The kind of 'you could steal his most precious belongings and he'd do nothing about it'-type vibe.
THE GOODEST YOU'VE ENCOUNTERED IN MONTHS.
You and me should be friends.
You sure fit a lot of dwarves into this tiny apartment.
E-"That's all for now. Thank you, citizen."
It should only be... five or so? How many are here now...
He looks around and taps his fingers to count.
Yeah, maybe a few too many right now. But it's just until the election. So it's fine.
Thank you for your sacrifice to the cause.
Is it really okay to keep it this cramped?
Yes. I'll have to... clean up afterwards.
The machine is a bit much... but printing is important to win the election.
You hear the tone of his voice adding on a 'I hope' at the end.
He appears uncomfortable with the current arrangements.
If only everyone was this agreeable.
Now push it. He can serve you well.
Did I say friends? I meant more like a... master-slave type dynamic.
The first frown in his life.
Too bad. You've already agreed to it.
Fair. I don't like it either. But what can you do?
He slowly joins your fist with his own.
The deal is sealed. You are now mine.
I have some other questions. Friend.
He looks around. Then he nods.
You're running gods damn circles around him.
He grunts and gestures towards Alfoz. "Ask the Foreman."
(Yell.) "Hey, Alfoz! Simii says you know something incriminating about the tea shop!"
Yeah, he did! Simii's a snitch!
Alfoz sure is a bit sensitive, isn't he? (Wink at Simii.)
I don't really care. I just ask so I can tell you about my political opinions.
You're not going to ask me what I'm voting for?
I'm actually not voting, because I am an apolitical entity.
He looks at you for a long while. His rocky endless wasteland of a face does not move an inch.
Then he opens his mouth and mutters out...
Completely without opinions. Of any kind.
I'm voting for the Party of Norvik.
I, too, am voting for the greens.
I'm voting for myself. Because I'm a great wizard, and I should be in charge.
This dwarf. Is he made out of stone or ethereal silk?
That face. That damn stern face doesn't give you anything. Love or hate.
This 'Simii'... he rivals the eldritch horrors of the Gate Era in his ineffable form.
